notes.title: Player-chosen encounters
notes.text: Optional (Settings, off by default): when you narrate that a wild Pokémon appears in front of you, the battle starts with it at a level near your lead. Wishes, plans and spoken lines never count; legendaries still need their quest. The AI is told to honour Thai or other spellings too.

notes.title: Every Pokémon uses the Pokémon header
notes.text: Species names, owner forms (Canari's Pikachu, Pikachu (Canari)) and pokemon IDs always resolve to a Pokémon header, ahead of any NPC record; Pokémon without an individual in the chat get a species header. The NPC system never creates a Pokémon as an NPC.

notes.title: Pokémon RPG cards 1.3.1
notes.text: The NPC archive has no Pokémon at all (2,857 trainer records). Gazette's and Alfmorii's legendary companions live in their lore and trainer records.
